name: storage-service-frontend
description: Tailwind CSS build for storage-service landing templates

scripts.build:css: tailwindcss -i ./assets/css/input.css -o ./static/css/site.css --minify && python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; p=Path('static/css/site.css'); b=p.read_bytes(); p.write_bytes(b.rstrip(b'\r\n')+b'\n')"
